description: master-slack skill documented using mdfind (macOS Spotlight) for path discovery, but mdfind is unavailable in non-interactive shell environments (scheduled tasks, agents). When agents invoke master-slack from scripted contexts, the mdfind command fails silently or returns nothing, breaking Slack notifications.
correction: Updated master-slack skill to use find-based path lookup that works in all environments: `find ~ -name 'SYSTEM.md' -path '*/jarvis/SYSTEM.md'`. This is portable across interactive and non-interactive shells, and works in CI/scheduled task environments.
systemic_fix: Documented three-tier path resolution strategy in master-slack skill: (1) mdfind for interactive shells, (2) find-based fallback for scripted environments, (3) direct $IES_ROOT usage if available. Updated all example code patterns.
